consent.privacy_policy.2026-09-12.text:
Privacy Policy — Version 2026-09-12

1. Data We Collect: We collect your basic information (name, phone number, Telegram ID), location data during service use, and trip and payment data.

2. Purpose of Collection: We use your data to provide the service, match you with drivers, process payments, and improve service quality.

3. Who Sees Your Data: Only authorized support team members access your data when needed. We do not share your data with third parties except with your consent or by court order.

4. Retention Period: We retain your data for as long as you use the service. You can request account deletion at any time, and your data will be deleted according to our retention policy.

5. Your Rights: You can download your data, correct it, or delete your account at any time from the application settings.
consent.privacy_policy.summary: What data we collect, why, who sees it, how long we keep it, and how you download your data or delete your account.
consent.privacy_policy.title: Privacy policy
consent.terms_of_service.2026-09-12.text:
Terms of Use — Version 2026-09-12

1. Scope of Service: These terms govern your use of the ride-hailing and delivery service provided by the application. By using the service, you agree to these terms in full.

2. User Obligations: You agree to provide accurate information, use the service for lawful purposes only, and not to abuse the system or attempt to harm it.

3. Our Commitments: We commit to providing the service to the best of our ability, protecting your data in accordance with our privacy policy, and handling your complaints seriously.

4. Limitation of Liability: We do not guarantee uninterrupted service or freedom from errors. Our liability is limited to the maximum extent permitted by applicable law.

5. Amendments: We may update these terms from time to time. The updated version will have a new version number, and your acceptance of the version you agreed to is recorded.
consent.terms_of_service.summary: The rules for using the service, what we owe you, what we expect from you, and the limits of our liability.

driver.account.basis.ATTENDANCE_PROVES_D: Your attendance record is itself the proof of what you earned; erasing it erases your own evidence before anyone else's.

driver.account.erasure.barStays: One last thing you should know before you press: if your account is blocked, or you carry a rating from your jobs, the block and the rating stay stored and apply to you again if you register with the same Telegram account or the same phone number. We do not keep your name or number for that, only a hashed fingerprint they cannot be recovered from. The reason is simple: erasure is your right, but it is not a way to shed a ban you earned or a rating riders gave you.

driver.account.erasure.refusal.WALLET_HA: Your subscription wallet holds {amount}. We do not erase an account while money is owed to or by you — contact support to settle it first; erasing now would lose a balance that is yours.
driver.account.erasure.warning: Erasing your account cannot be undone. You will lose your job history and the documents you uploaded, and you will not be able to recover them or work with this account again.
driver.account.erasure.whatStays: Some things stay by rule: your consent stays as proof that we asked you; riders' ratings of you stay because they are testimony that belongs to them; support and safety reports stay because they may be disputed; and money entries, subscription invoices and your attendance record stay because they are accounting books kept both for you and against you. After the erasure we will show you exactly what was erased, what stayed, and why.

welcome.after_consent_body: The ride request, pricing and tracking screens are not built yet (items F2-02 to F2-12). Your consent really is recorded now, and no request screen waits behind it — we say so plainly instead of showing a button that leads nowhere.
welcome.consent_required_hint: Both are required, and each is recorded separately with its own timestamp.
welcome.consent_superseded: The document changed after your earlier consent, so we ask again.
welcome.error.account_not_found: You do not have an account with us yet. Send /start to the bot first, then reopen the app.
welcome.error.rejected: The consent was not accepted as sent. Try again, and if it repeats, reopen the app.
welcome.error.session: Your session expired or was not accepted. Reopen the app from Telegram.
welcome.error.unavailable: The consent service is unavailable right now. Nothing was recorded, and retrying is safe.
welcome.error.version_not_current: The copy your app is showing is out of date and the document has changed. Reopen the app to read the current version before accepting.
welcome.language_note: Language changes this screen's text now. Saving it to your account is item F2-11 — we do not claim it is saved today.
welcome.line1: Rides and deliveries in your city, from inside Telegram — no app to install.
welcome.line2: You pick your destination and get an estimate from a real route — and when we cannot compute one we say «unavailable» rather than guess.
welcome.line3: Before we start: read the terms and the privacy policy and accept them. The time you accept is recorded.
welcome.location_note: We do not ask for location permission on this screen. We ask at the moment it is needed, when you set a destination.
welcome.title: Waslah
